## Summary

I build mechanical and electronic projects, then document the tests, revisions, and open problems.

## Current Stack

- 01: Garden Party pinball
- 02: Smart pot PCB / enclosure

## Main Projects

### A01 Garden Party Pinball
Status: active build
Label: flagship electromechanical build
A full-size homebrew pinball machine using FAST boards, Mission Pinball Framework, real coils, switches, lamps, cabinet wiring, and a revised playfield.
Evidence: FAST Pinball boards, Mission Pinball Framework, coils / switches / lamps, CAD + wiring revisions
Media: 2 slots, 0 live, 2 placeholders
To document next: photos, playfield CAD, wiring maps, MPF configs, driver tests, rule notes

### A02 Smart Self-Watering Pot
Status: reviving / redesigning
Label: embedded product redesign
A plant-care device with moisture sensing, pump control, electronics packaging, and an enclosure/PCB redesign.
Evidence: ESP32 / Arduino-style control, pump driver, sensor input, KiCad + enclosure planning
Media: 2 slots, 0 live, 2 placeholders
To document next: schematic, board outline, enclosure constraints, connector plan, watering state machine

### A03 TETC 3D Printing Showcase
Status: showcase work
Label: technical communication
A technical showcase explaining 3D printing with SolidWorks models, printed demos, robotics examples, and presentation materials.
Evidence: SolidWorks models, printed demos, robotics angle, public explanation
Media: 2 slots, 0 live, 2 placeholders
To document next: model screenshots, printed examples, final presentation notes

### A04 CAD Mechanism Studies
Status: ongoing library
Label: mechanical skill building
SolidWorks studies for mechanisms, assemblies, print-ready parts, clearances, and tolerances.

Media: 2 slots, 0 live, 2 placeholders

## Smaller Projects

- Subpix - desktop app: Open-source Electron, Vite, React, and TypeScript editor for .subpix files, RGB/BGR subpixel canvases, JSON validation, PNG export, and Windows packaging. ([project](https://subpix-editor.vercel.app/), [source](https://github.com/Chrissyuh/Subpix)). Media: 2 slots, 0 live, 2 placeholders.
- Check-ins - live web app: Live web app for logging check-ins and tracking target gaps, max gaps, and progress. ([project](https://check-ins-zeta.vercel.app/)). Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
- MPF Hardware Test Tools - pinball utilities: Pinball test utilities for checking switches, coils, LEDs, board maps, and FAST hardware before full rules. Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.

## C-Level Projects

- MIDI Practice Tool - python / music: Python practice tool for soundfonts, pedals, controls, and keyboard-style interaction. Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
- Desmos 3D Solar System - math visualization: 3D math visualization using surfaces, orbits, color mapping, and performance tradeoffs. ([project](https://www.desmos.com/3d/qcjp33t4ij)). Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
- TinyGPT Experiments - machine learning: Learning project on small next-token models and how pretraining differs from instruction following. Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
- VEX V5 Drivetrain Prototype - robotics prototype: Robot drivetrain prototype built around gearing, packaging, shafts, and structure clearance. Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.

## Skills

- Mechanical design: I use CAD to test clearances, assemblies, print orientation, mounting, and fabrication before building parts.
- Hardware + electronics: I work with wiring, sensors, actuators, power routing, and controller behavior in the same system.
- Software as a tool for hardware: I write code for MPF configs, hardware tests, embedded control, web tools, and debugging workflows.
- AI-assisted engineering workflow: I use ChatGPT for planning, debugging, documentation, and code review, then check decisions against real tests.

## Working Vocabulary

SolidWorks, FAST Pinball, Mission Pinball Framework, Arduino / ESP32, KiCad basics, 3D printing, laser cutting, mechanism design, sensor wiring, pump / motor control, technical presentation, rapid iteration, ChatGPT-assisted debugging, Electron, React, TypeScript, Vite, desktop packaging

## Documentation Standards

- Show the mechanism: Show CAD, wiring, test setup, constraints, and why the design exists.
- Document revisions: When a wiring map, enclosure, or design choice fails, explain what changed.
- Prefer working artifacts: Prioritize hardware, test videos, CAD screenshots, measurements, code, and build logs.

### Flagship engineering
